passage: Last Thursday evening, my family and I faced a small problem at home. At around seven o'clock, the lights went out suddenly, and the whole apartment turned dark. My wife looked at me and asked what had happened. I checked the switch on the wall, but it did not work. Then I opened the door and looked outside. The lights in the next building were also off, so I knew it was not only our problem. My son felt a little scared, so I lit two candles and placed them on the table. My wife found a flashlight in a drawer and handed it to me. We sat down together and waited for the power to return. To pass the time, my mother told us a story about her childhood, when her family used oil lamps every night. We listened quietly and laughed at the funny parts. After about an hour, the lights came back on, and the room felt bright again. I checked the fridge and turned the television back on. My son cheered, and we finished our dinner together. That night taught me a simple lesson: a dark evening can still bring a family closer.

coach_rationale: 今天继续本周重点：过去式动词结尾 -ed/-t/-d 的听辨（10 月 10 日听写 64%，gave/showed/felt 系统性丢分），文里埋了 faced、looked、checked、turned、listened、cheered 等 20 多个过去式动词；同时加练短语动词连读 went out、came back on、sat down、turned back on，呼应你 EnglishPod 笔记里 pick up a、fill me in、kicked me out 这类连读弱项。主题换成家庭日常——停电的一晚，B1 复合句（when、while、after、so）密度保持，听写仍按 B1、跟读保持 A2。
